thread:
jana: Quick sync — thinking about shipping telemetry-driven "adaptive presets" for per-route/per-model views.
jana: Goal: surface a small set of saved views per route that match real traffic patterns (seq len, common prompts, successful models) so customers see high-signal analytics by default.
alex: I sketched a compact UI: left rail shows `Suggested` (telemetry-ranked) + `Pinned` + `All saved`. Suggestion chips show a short reason: "high traffic", "long seqs".
mike: Backend implications: need an API to return ranked presets per-route with reason strings. Also need to pin scope: route vs model vs global.
tara: Telemetry side: we can compute signals daily: top-k routes by qps, model hitrate, seq length distribution, error rate. We already export these to telemetry-db.
ryan: Concern: generating per-route suggestions for 10k routes could be heavy. We should precompute for routes with > threshold (e.g., 50 req/day) and fallback to global suggestions.
jana: Agreed. UX-wise we default show only for routes meeting threshold; UX shows a small badge "suggested (based on traffic)". If no suggestions, show quick tips.
alex: One open question: when we add a suggested preset, does it create a saved_query object server-side (visible to team) or only a client-side transient view?
mike: Prefer server-side saved_query so it can be shared, audited, and included in rollouts. But that means DB write/migration and auth checks.
tara: Migration idea: write suggested saved_queries with owner="system:telemetry-suggest" and a flag `suggested=true` so customers can convert to pinned. We can garbage-collect old suggestions.
ryan: API contract proposal (very tiny):
```
GET /routes/{route_id}/suggested-presets
Response: [{
  id: "s-20260310-1",
  scope: "route", // route | model | global
  filter_expr: "model:cohort-v2 AND tok_count>256",
  reason: "high long-seq traffic (24h)",
  created_by: "system:telemetry-suggest",
  suggested: true
}]
```
mike: Implementation notes: we'll add `suggested` column (bool) and `reason` text. Need index on route_id + suggested for fast fetch. Also add a background job to compute suggestions daily.
jana: Rollout plan: 1) API + DB change behind feature flag, 2) internal canary on 5% routes (low-traffic subset) for 2 weeks, 3) expand to 25% if metrics OK, 4) global.
alex: Metrics to watch: click-through to suggested views, conversion to pinned/saved, errors, additional DB writes, UI render latency.
tara: Telemetry alert thresholds: if conversion rate < 0.5% -> UX bad? not necessarily. If suggested views cause >1% increase in saved_query writes/day, alert billing/ops.
ryan: Also watch per-request latency on /routes/{id}/insights endpoint. Suggested fetch should not add >20ms p50.
mike: Migration caveat: existing saved_query schema v2 -> v3 — we need a small migration script. Pseudocode:
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE saved_queries ADD COLUMN suggested boolean DEFAULT false;
ALTER TABLE saved_queries ADD COLUMN reason text;
UPDATE saved_queries SET suggested=false WHERE created_by NOT LIKE 'system:%';
COMMIT;
```

mike: We'll deploy migration during low-traffic window and run the background job in a separate deployment.

jena: UX ask: add a quick "dismiss suggestion" so users can hide a suggested preset without deleting (sets suggested_hidden=true for that user).
alex: We'll add a client-side flag + server API to persist per-user hides. That keeps DB small.
ryan: Auth note: suggested saved_queries should be readable by org members but not editable unless converted. Add `editable=false` for suggested objects.
mike: OK — I'll draft the API PR and migration. Will ping eng-infra for the index.
tara: I'll produce a daily job + sample SQL query for signal extraction and post in #eng-ml tomorrow.
jana: Thanks all. @mike and @alex, can you pair on the staging UX by EOD Fri? I'll follow up with rollout doc.
alex: Yup, pairing OK. I'll post mocks here: https://redwood.design/telemetry-presets/mocks

jana: Quick note: if we see unexpected increase in saved_query writes, cap suggested creation by per-org rate (e.g., 10/day) — avoid spamming small orgs.
ryan: I'll add that rate limiter in the service layer.
mike: Thanks — will add tests for rate limiting and suggested flag behavior.
jana: Wrapping up: I'll draft the rollout checklist and add owners. Nice work.
